question: A parking garage had 176 cars parked at opening time in the morning. By midmorning, 39 more cars pulled in, though the tour bus company, which normally reserved a dozen spots just for its own buses, wasn't part of this count. At midday, 8 additional cars arrived for a lunch rush. In the afternoon, 187 cars left for a downtown event. By evening, 17 more cars departed as offices closed. Late at night, 56 more cars pulled in for a concert. How many cars were in the garage at the end of the night?

A stamp collector owned 223 stamps in his album at the beginning of the year. In spring, he traded away 193 stamps to a fellow collector for a rare set. He then lost 2 stamps when a page got damaged in a move. Over the summer, an estate sale added 42 more stamps to his collection. In the fall, a museum donation brought in 52 additional stamps. A national exhibition award then grew his entire collection to 9 times its size. Afterward, he gave half of that award collection to his nephew to start his own hobby, keeping the rest for himself. How many stamps did the collector keep?

Priya scored 154 points in the first round of a video game tournament. A double-points power-up she picked up made her round total grow to 2 times its size. She then lost 64 points when a hidden trap wiped out part of her combo streak. Her rival, Jonas, had scored far fewer points overall and was already out of contention for the finals. In the bonus round, Priya earned 3 more points for a perfect combo. A final multiplier event for the top players made her total grow to 8 times its size. What was Priya's final score?

Priya's jar held 225 coins at the start of summer, far more than her cousin Wesley's much smaller jar. She added 5 more coins she found under her couch cushions. She then spent 106 coins on a toy at the arcade, ignoring her grandmother's separate collection of foreign coins from over 40 different countries. Priya divided her remaining coins evenly across 4 piggy banks and kept tracking just one. A prize drawing then grew that piggy bank's total to 5 times its size. Finally, she added 3 more coins she earned for chores. How many coins were in that piggy bank?

A concession stand run by Rosa started the game with 206 hot dogs in stock, far more than Jake's rival stand kept on hand nearby. During the first quarter, 153 hot dogs were sold. A halftime rush meant Rosa had to prepare 7 times as many hot dogs as what was left, pulling extra stock from the freezer. Over the third quarter, 264 hot dogs were sold to the crowd. By the fourth quarter, 90 more hot dogs were sold before the stand closed. How many hot dogs were left unsold at closing?

At dawn, a charity walk-a-thon began with 7 teams, each pledging to raise 46 dollars for every mile completed as a base pledge. By morning, 6 more dollars had been pledged by a walk-up donor. At midday, a local business added 52 dollars to the fund. In the afternoon, a matching-donation drive brought in 29 more dollars. By evening, a final surge of last-minute donations added 26 more dollars. How much money had the walk-a-thon raised by evening?

Two friends, Maria and Julio, tracked reward points during a weekend charity challenge, and Julio's total stayed far below hers all day. Maria started the morning with 191 points, then earned 78 more before noon for completing a puzzle station. In the afternoon, a penalty deducted 164 points after a rules violation, and a referee's review cost her 4 more points shortly after. In the evening, a bonus challenge added 56 points to her score. Right before the final scoring, a special multiplier made her tally grow to 8 times its size. At the very end, a closing penalty cost her 586 points all at once. What was Maria's final score?

A science class started an experiment with 84 bacteria in a petri dish, and their lab assistant kept a dozen spare dishes on a shelf just in case, though those were never used. During the first growth cycle, the colony grew to 4 times its size. During the second growth cycle, it grew to 4 times its size again. During the third growth cycle, it grew to 4 times its size once more. Finally, a nutrient boost caused one last growth spurt, bringing the colony to 7 times its size. How many bacteria were in the dish after the final spurt?

A stadium box office started the day with 4 windows open, each having sold 133 tickets before the gates opened. A separate souvenir stand, which had 200 unsold t-shirts left over from last season, wasn't part of the ticket count. Once the gates opened, 10 more tickets were sold to walk-up fans. During halftime, 26 more tickets were sold at a discount. After a printing error voided some sales, 69 tickets had to be refunded. How many valid tickets were sold in total?

A food bank started the morning with 145 pounds of rice in storage. By midmorning, 120 pounds were distributed to local families. The remaining rice was then repackaged into 8 equally sized batches for a partner shelter, and the total delivered equaled all 8 batches combined. In the afternoon, a grocery store donated 8 more pounds, and later that day a farm delivered 27 more pounds. Since the food bank logs weight in pounds but its national report converts everything to kilograms, staff always double-checked the numbers before submitting it. By evening, a final donation added 74 more pounds. How many pounds of rice did the food bank have by evening?

A toy store began the morning with 122 puzzle boxes on the shelf. By afternoon, 34 boxes had been sold to customers. A back-room delivery then made the remaining stock grow to 4 times its size. The store manager, who had ordered 90 extra shopping bags that never got used, wasn't worried about the backlog. That evening, a clearance return brought in 74 more boxes. Overnight, the boxes were split evenly across 3 storage shelves, and only one shelf's count was tracked going forward. How many puzzle boxes were on that shelf the next morning?

Two stamp collectors, Leo and Priti, compared their collections at a convention, and Leo's was noticeably smaller than hers. Priti's album held 160 stamps at the start of the convention, and a trade with another collector added 52 more stamps. A rare-set bonus then made her collection grow to 9 times its size. A special exhibit prize made it grow to 9 times its size once again, while the organizer's 3000 extra entry passes sat unused in a box. Afterward, 14004 stamps had to be returned to their rightful owners after an authentication review found they didn't belong to her. How many stamps remained in Priti's album?

A charity raffle sold tickets across 5 identical booths, each booth collecting 211 dollars by the end of the morning. An extra donation added 11 more dollars to the combined total. A processing fee of 353 dollars was then deducted before the funds could be transferred. A matching-grant program made the remaining total grow to 7 times its size. A final citywide match then made that new total grow to 4 times its size. How much money did the raffle ultimately raise?

Two shop owners, Isla and Ravi, tracked their coin drawer totals all day, and Ravi's drawer stayed noticeably lower than hers. Isla's drawer held 171 dollars at the start of the morning, and by midmorning, 11 more dollars came in from early customers. At midday, a bulk sale event made her total grow to 3 times its size. In the afternoon, 54 more dollars came in from a big order. Since her register logs everything in dollars and cents but the bank statement lists whole-dollar figures only, she always rounded carefully before her evening deposit, when the drawer's total was split evenly across 6 cash envelopes and only one envelope was tracked into the next day. Overnight, a matching bonus made that envelope grow to 6 times its size, and a final coupon reimbursement added 13 more dollars the next morning. How much money was in that envelope by the next morning?

A charity blood drive began the morning with 96 pints donated, while the hospital's separate supply closet held a dozen unopened testing kits that weren't used that day. By midmorning, 40 more pints came in. At midday, 43 more pints were donated. In the afternoon, 64 more pints arrived from a mobile unit. By evening, 61 more pints were donated at a community center. A regional shortage alert then required the blood bank to grow its stock to 9 times its size for redistribution. Late that night, a final donation added 64 more pints. How many pints were in the blood bank's stock after the final donation?

Two neighbors, Priya and Sam, kept track of firewood, and Sam's stack always fell behind hers all week. Priya split her stack across 8 identical bundles each holding 162 logs at the start of the morning, then combined them into one pile. By midmorning, a delivery added 33 more logs. In the afternoon, a neighbor gave her 70 more logs to store for the winter. That evening, a bonfire event used up 320 logs. Late that night, 58 more logs were given away to a cold family down the street. How many logs did Priya have left?

A juice company filled 240 liters into storage on Monday. The stock was then multiplied across 4 identical bottling lines, each producing an equal amount, bringing the total to 4 times its size. A recall then required splitting that batch evenly across 4 storage rooms, and only one room's share continued to be tracked. A separate unrelated shipment, sitting in a different warehouse, held 900 empty crates that were never filled. That tracked room's stock then grew to 4 times its size after a rush production order. The stock was next divided evenly between 2 delivery trucks, and only one truck's load was tracked further. Finally, 68 more liters were added from a backup tank before the truck left. How many liters did that truck carry?

A toy drive collected 102 action figures by the start of the week. A local business added 53 more figures on Tuesday, and a school donated 66 more figures on Wednesday. A nearby food pantry, running its own separate campaign, gathered 300 canned goods that had nothing to do with this drive. On Thursday, a matching-donor event made the toy count grow to 7 times its size. By Friday, 153 figures had to be set aside for a different charity's request. How many action figures were left for the original toy drive?

Two coworkers, Delia and Ronan, tracked their sales commissions, and Ronan's numbers stayed behind hers all week. In the morning, Delia closed 7 identical deals, each worth 108 dollars, adding up her commission for the day. By midmorning, a client dispute canceled 727 dollars worth of that commission. In the afternoon, 20 more dollars were deducted for a processing fee. That evening, a bonus program made her remaining total grow to 3 times its size. Right before closing, a second incentive made it grow to 3 times its size once more. Overnight, a correction to the books removed 70 more dollars. What was Delia's final commission?

A charity concert began the morning with 6 ticket booths, each having sold 191 tickets by opening time, combined into one grand total. By midmorning, 56 more tickets were sold, while a nearby food stand, run separately with a dozen volunteers, wasn't included in this count. In the afternoon, a bulk group purchase made the total grow to 9 times its size. Later, 6948 tickets had to be refunded after a scheduling conflict canceled a section. That evening, 27 more tickets were sold at the door. Overnight, a final accounting correction removed 3161 tickets that had been double-counted. How many valid tickets remained after the correction?

A recycling center started Monday with 136 pounds of aluminum cans collected. A community drive added 71 more pounds on Tuesday, while a dozen volunteers sorted plastic in a separate unrelated bin. On Wednesday, 147 pounds were shipped out to a processing plant. The remaining cans were then divided evenly across 5 collection routes, and only one route's total was tracked going forward. A weekend rush made that route's total grow to 4 times its size. Finally, 37 more pounds were added from a new drop-off bin. How many pounds of aluminum did that route have?

Two classmates, Tara and Milo, tracked their reading minutes, and Milo's total, a dozen minutes behind at the start, never quite caught up. Tara read 118 minutes in week one. She added 49 more minutes in week two. She then added 10 more minutes in week three. A slow week four saw her total drop by 118 minutes after a family trip cut into her reading time. A strong week five added 64 more minutes. How many total minutes had Tara read by the end of week five?

A bakery began the morning with 4 ovens, each holding 164 rolls ready to bake, combining into one big batch. By midmorning, a shipping error caused 278 rolls to be sent to the wrong store, while a dozen spare baking trays sat unused in the back room. In the afternoon, 10 more rolls came out of a late batch, and later 13 more rolls were added from a walk-in order. Since the bakery weighs dough in ounces but sells rolls by count, the head baker kept two separate logs. By evening, 28 rolls were donated to a shelter. Overnight, 253 more rolls had to be discarded after a refrigeration failure. How many rolls were left the next morning?

A parking meter held 193 minutes of prepaid time at the start of the trip. A short walk cost 2 minutes to reach the car. Feeding the meter added 74 more minutes. The remaining time was then split evenly across 5 parking zones sharing one pass, and only one zone's balance was tracked. Since meters charge in minutes but the receipt reports the total in hours, the driver always converted the number before leaving. A final minute ticked away just before the driver returned. How many minutes were left on that zone's balance?

Two siblings, Owen and Kira, compared their saved allowance, and Kira's stash was noticeably smaller than his. Owen started with 24 dollars saved. He earned 51 more dollars doing chores. He then earned 70 more dollars from a birthday gift. His savings were split evenly across 5 jars, and only one jar was tracked going forward. That jar then lost 13 dollars when he bought a video game. A bonus from grandma made that jar's total grow to 8 times its size. How much money was in that jar?
